sin.name: python-frozen-default
sin.description: a parameter defaulted to `datetime.now()`, `uuid4()` or another call that answers differently each time — it runs once when the def is defined, so every call that omits it gets the moment the module was imported
sin.rule: A default is a value, not a computation: anything that must be worked out per call is worked out in the body.
sin.suggestion: Default it to `None` and call it inside the body, so each call gets its own answer. It is the container default's twin and takes the same repair.
